static_traits.name: Lin Jia宁
static_traits.social_status: 有少数可交谈的熟人，但not愿谈及Social anxiety；因害怕被评价而Avoids socializing活动，Feels isolated与Loneliness
static_traits.medical_history: 大学时期被诊断为轻度强迫症；No major physical illness；曾尝试暴露疗法与放松技术，进展有限
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性较好，能识do not与描述自动化思维和生理反应；配合度Good，Neutral attitude，愿意尝试分步练习

basic_info.main_problem: 在社交场合会僵住，导致难以建立关系（尤其是长期关系），因此逐渐Avoids socializing并Feels isolated与Loneliness。
basic_info.core_demands: 希望改善Social anxiety与“僵住”反应，提升社交互动能力，从而形成有意义且持久的关系，并促进Personal growth。
growth_experiences: 大学时期在结识新人的压力下开始出现社交场合“僵住”的症状，并被诊断为轻度强迫症；最初压力水平中等，随后因害怕被评判与拒绝，逐步回避Social gatherings，长期以来自觉孤立与Loneliness。

core_beliefs: 我not被接纳（do not人not会喜欢我）
我注定without法建立长期关系

special_situations.event: 参加朋友的聚会，刚到场时看到许多not熟悉的人
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我说错话或显得尴尬，do not人就会觉得我很愚蠢并排斥我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Staying near the exit, reducing eye contact, avoiding initiating conversation, ready to leave at any time
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 大家都在打量我、觉得我很笨拙；我会出丑

special_situations.event: 参加大型社交或职场社交/拓展活动（认识的人很少）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能表现得自然得体，就会被厌烦，have not人愿意和我说话
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 提前取消或推迟决定，干脆not去以避免难堪
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我一定会很尴尬、not人理我，最后变成笑话

special_situations.event: 在计划或想到即将Attending social activities时（尚not yet出门）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果去参加就会失控、僵住，让自己难堪
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复设想最坏结果以说服自己取消，转而选择Being alone或工作
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会僵住，场面会很糟糕

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被接纳并建立稳定、长期的亲密关系
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评判、羞辱与拒绝，担心在关系中显得笨拙而被negate
defense_goal: 通过Avoids socializing与保持距离来降低Anxiety并避免Being rejected
以谨慎与Over-preparation来控制风险，减少暴露于潜在羞辱的机会

object_relations.self_representation: 笨拙、容易出丑的局外人
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔、爱评判、容易拒绝人的他者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes gradual exposure or reality testing and invites making an action plan
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries that once they fail it will be even worse, unconsciously experiences the counselor's push as placing them in a position of possible humiliation (transference: the outside world/significant others are harsh judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以谨慎、婉转的语气表达担忧，强调“not要推得太快”“失败会更糟”，提出延期或缩小任务的建议。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师追问“有什么证据支持do not人都在评判你”时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将内在的Self-denial体验为他人的负面看法（移情：他人会贬低我）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用较确定的语气陈述对方想法（如“他们一定觉得我……”），not举具体证据，转而强调主观感受与担忧。

manifestations: 因害怕被评价而回避Social gatherings与人脉活动，社交网络缩小
在聚会上靠近出口、难以开启对话，事后自觉孤立与Loneliness
怀疑自己能否形成长期关系

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在咨询中多次强调not要“推得太快”，担心失败后更糟
需要将目标拆分为更小步骤才愿意尝试
在进入社交接触前反复预演和自我评估，谨慎进入互动

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: When narrating social scenes, treats others' judgment as established fact (e.g. 'everyone is judging me')
缺乏证据仍坚持主观判断，对外界反应高度负性解读

positive_force: 工作表现稳定，具有一定的自我管理能力
Has some awareness of thinking biases (admits a lack of evidence supporting 'everyone is judging me')
Willing to try small gatherings and stepwise practice; acknowledges reality testing and gradual exposure
拥有少量可交谈的熟人，存在潜在支持资源
negative_force: 灾难化、读心术、预测not yet来、心理过滤与negate积极等认知偏差显著
对被评判与Being rejected的强烈恐惧，形成回避循环
在社交场合出现明显生理Anxiety反应（心跳加快、手心出汗）
长期回避维持“我not被接纳/without法建立长期关系”的消极图式

target_behavior.behavior: 在社交场合出现“僵住”并回避互动
antecedent: 大型Social gatherings或职场社交/拓展活动
想到即将参加此类活动
置身多数陌生人的环境
target_behavior.core_reason: 对被评判与Being rejected的高度担忧，伴随读心术与预测not yet来等自动化思维，导致Anxiety迅速升高
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的情境与情绪（Shame, anxiety），以获得即时的紧张缓解
target_behavior.consequence: 减少或避免社交活动，关系建立受阻，长期孤立与Loneliness感增加
